label: Breath
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Air is the gauge: it drains each beat and comes back when a breathing window is caught.
promptHint: The commander is short of air; breathing is restricted by the contact.

label: Weight
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Strength is the gauge: it drains while a load is held, and letting go is a slip.
promptHint: A load rests on the commander, who must hold still under it.

label: Saturation
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: The air is thick with her scent or sweat; the gauge fills, and breathing through the mouth lowers it but is noticed.
promptHint: The air is saturated with her scent; perception is crowded.

label: Tongue work
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Cleaning with the tongue: dirt falls as the right part is chosen next; at the end she checks.
promptHint: The commander is cleaning with the tongue, part by part.

label: Her task
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Her own task runs on: pages of the report, the time of the call. Only moments happen; endure until she finishes.
promptHint: Her attention is on her own task; the contact goes on under it.

label: Jaw
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Fatigue fills as the mouth is held open; speech and letters degrade, and a rest can be asked for.
promptHint: The jaw is held open and tires; speech degrades.

label: Keeping up
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Swallows have windows; a miss is a spill, and a spill chains to tongue work with dirt 60.
promptHint: The commander must keep up with the flow, swallow by swallow.
